Work published before 2023 appears under my maiden name, **Katarzyna Murat**.
The same record is available on [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0004-2454-5950) and
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=YPBOoe8AAAAJ); a BibTeX file of everything on
this page is here: [`references.bib`](references.bib).
